scope: Quantity alternatives and CSV export for the disposable workshop-card proof app; not a governing process change

build_comparison.input: A list or tuple of 1 through 8 distinct integers, excluding bool; each within provider MIN_QUANTITY..MAX_QUANTITY. Reject strings, mappings, generators, empty/oversize sequences, duplicate normalized quantities, nonintegers and out-of-bounds values with ValueError.
build_comparison.semantics: Rows are alternatives, never a combined order. No aggregate total, fabricated discount or changed provider pricing. Provider values are injected, never hardcoded.

to_csv.rows: Same order as comparison.rows; integer values only, one row per alternative. No currency symbols or floats.

routes./compare: Fresh form when no query string; otherwise validate exactly one quantities parameter and render comparison or HTML 400
routes./compare.csv: Validate exactly one quantities parameter, emit valid CSV attachment or HTML 400

web.input_control: Labelled textarea; raw submitted text retained and HTML escaped on validation errors
web.grammar: Comma or newline separators; strip surrounding token whitespace; each token nonempty ASCII unsigned decimal digits only. Reject empty tokens, including trailing separators; signs, exponent, decimal, non-ASCII digits, duplicate normalized quantities, and fewer than 1 or more than 8 alternatives. All-or-nothing validation.
web.query_validation: Missing/empty quantities on a submitted query and duplicate quantities parameters return 400. Unknown unrelated parameters do not substitute for quantities.
web.fresh_defaults: Use 2,12,50 at the current provider contract. With changed provider bounds, derive valid unique alternatives by clamping these examples into the provider range and removing duplicates in order; no invalid fresh default.
web.model_consumption: Call the injected report module, never duplicate pricing logic. Show provider-driven bounds/unit price, a comparison table and a CSV download link. Preserve every existing single-quote route/behavior; include navigation between flows.
web.injection: Optional report_path argument to create_server and optional CLI --report-path; default sibling report directory so existing development-plan argv remains valid.

delivery_sequence: Report JOB 1 implements comparison model plus CLI text/JSON output
Independent web JOB builds complete UI against an injected report stub
Report JOB 2 adds CSV export plus CLI CSV format, preserving the frozen API
Web final module verification uses actual integrated report dependency before acceptance
